items.key:
A design brings different observations together. Trace how people reach the places they use, where water is observed or reported, and where shade changes. Consider how the same arrangement might work in different conditions. Keep a useful access route in view while thinking about a new growing area.

The position of a water point does not tell you how much suitable water is reliably available. A tank drawn higher on a map is not necessarily higher on the ground. A flow arrow does not supply levels, soil information, a safe outlet or permission to redirect water. Those questions need appropriate evidence and, where relevant, qualified help. Keep drainage and construction proposals separate from what is already known.

A photograph of a green site does not prove year-round supply. Ask what changes during dry periods, rain, cold or household absence. Use local records and the existing seasonal-planning lessons to decide what else to observe. Do not copy a calendar or a fixed compass rule from another place without checking its relevance.

Some constraints change the scope of a proposal. If water, access or care is unresolved, improving a smaller existing area may be worth comparing with expansion. Deferring a feature can be a sound design decision. Explain the missing evidence and the next action so “later” does not mean forgotten.

Uyilo lubeka kunye ulwazi olwahlukeneyo. Landela indlela abantu abafikelela ngayo kwiindawo abazisebenzisayo, apho amanzi ajongwe okanye ebikwe khona, nalapho umthunzi utshintsha khona. Cinga indlela olo lungiselelo lunokusebenza ngayo kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo. Gcina indlela yofikelelo eluncedo ibonakala ngoxa ucinga ngendawo entsha yokutyala.

Indawo yendawo yamanzi ayichazi ukuba mangaphi amanzi afanelekileyo afumaneka ngokuthembekileyo. Itanki ezotywe phezulu kwimephu ayiphezulu ngokufuneka emhlabeni. Utolo lokuhamba kwamanzi aluniki miphakamo, ulwazi lomhlaba, indawo ekhuselekileyo yokuphuma okanye imvume yokuguqula amanzi. Le mibuzo ifuna ubungqina obufanelekileyo kwaye, apho kufanelekileyo, uncedo olufanelekileyo. Gcina iziphakamiso zokuphuma kwamanzi nokwakha zahlukile koko sele kwaziwa.

Ifoto yendawo eluhlaza ayiqinisekisi ukubakho konyaka wonke. Buza kutshintsha ntoni ngexesha lomlinyo, imvula, ukubanda okanye xa ikhaya lingekho. Sebenzisa iirekhodi zalapha nezifundo zocwangciso lweziqendu zonyaka ukuze ugqibe ukuba yintoni enye ekufuneka uyijonge. Musa ukukopa ikhalenda okanye umgaqo ongaguquki wekhampasi kwenye indawo ngaphandle kokukhangela ukuhambelana kwawo.

Eminye imiqobo itshintsha ububanzi besiphakamiso. Ukuba amanzi, ufikelelo okanye unonophelo alukaxazululwa, ukuphucula indawo encinci esele ikho kunokufaneleka ukuthelekiswa nokwandisa. Ukubambezela into kunokuba sisigqibo soyilo esilungileyo. Chaza ubungqina obulahlekileyo nesenzo esilandelayo ukuze “kamva” kungathethi “kulityiwe”.

items.key:
A useful connection is more than a line between two objects. Ask what each part needs, what it produces, who cares for it and how things move between the parts. A compost area may receive suitable material and supply finished compost, but someone must sort, carry and manage it. Its position must allow that work and suit local hygiene and site conditions.

Write needs and outputs beside the elements you are considering. Include water, suitable materials, space, access, time and skills. Do not count an output before it is available and suitable for its intended use. A proposed animal system does not provide free fertility: animals also require care, feed, water, welfare and management of wastes.

Look for useful connections, but also conflicts. A convenient position might obstruct a route. One person's useful output might create another person's handling burden. A connection that needs daily attention can fail if nobody agrees to provide it. Keep bought inputs and materials leaving the site in the picture; a neat cycle diagram does not prove that everything is supplied on site.
items.draft:
Unxulumano oluncedo ungaphezu komgca phakathi kwezinto ezibini. Buza ukuba inxalenye nganye iyidingayo, ivelisa ntoni, ngubani oyinyamekelayo nokuba izinto ziqhutywa njani phakathi kwamacandelo. Indawo yomgquba inokwamkela izinto ezifanelekileyo ize inike umgquba ogqityiweyo, kodwa kufuneka umntu ahlele, athwale aze aphathe. Indawo yawo kufuneka ivumele loo msebenzi kwaye ifanele ukhuseleko lwendawo neemeko zesiza.

Bhala iimfuno nezinto ezivelisiweyo ecaleni kweempawu ozicingayo. Bandakanya amanzi, izinto ezifanelekileyo, indawo, ufikelelo, ixesha nezakhono. Musa ukubala into evelisiweyo phambi kokuba ikhoyo ifaneleke injongo yayo. Inkqubo yezilwanyana ecetywayo ayinikeli ntlaninge yasimahla: izilwanyana nazo zifuna unonophelo, ukutya, amanzi, impilo yazo kunye nolawulo lwenkunkuma.

Khangela unxulumano oluluncedo, kodwa ukhangele nokungavisisani. Indawo elungileyo inokuvala indlela. Into evelisiweyo eluncedo komnye umntu ingadala umthwalo wokuyiphatha komnye. Unxulumano oludinga ingqalelo yemihla ngemihla lunokuphoxa ukuba akukho mntu uvumayo ukuluhlangabezana. Gcina izinto ezithengiweyo nezinto ezishiya indawo zibonakala; umzobo wesangqa ococekileyo awubonisi ukuba yonke into ibonelelwa kwindawo.

items.key:
Compare the options against the criteria you wrote from the brief. Start with needs that cannot be traded away: usable access, agreed care, required permissions and a proposal's basic suitability. Then consider benefits, burdens, costs and what may change over time.

Use words and evidence references. “Possible, but water evidence is missing” is more honest than a precise-looking score with no basis. If you use a scoring exercise, agree what each score means and who chooses the priorities. Adding scores must not cancel an unresolved safety or permission requirement.

Ask the household to explain the choice in its own words. A designer's preference should not quietly replace the household's priorities. Record why an option was chosen, why another was set aside and what new information could change the decision. A conditional choice is valid when its condition is clear and the affected work waits.

Thelekisa iinketho nemigangatho oyibhale kwisishwankathelo. Qala ngeemfuno ezingenakuthengiswa: ufikelelo olusebenzayo, unonophelo olwavunyelwanayo, iimvume ezifunekayo nokufaneleka okusisiseko kwesiphakamiso. Emva koko qwalasela iinzuzo, imithwalo, iindleko nento enokutshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha.

Sebenzisa amagama neencwadi zobungqina. “Kunokwenzeka, kodwa ubungqina bamanzi bulahlekile” kunyanisekile ngakumbi kunenqaku elibonakala lichanekile ngaphandle kwesiseko. Ukuba usebenzisa umsebenzi wokunika amanqaku, vumelanani ukuba inqaku ngalinye sithetha ntoni nokuba ngubani okhetha izinto eziphambili. Ukudibanisa amanqaku akufuneki kurhoxise imfuno engaxazululwanga yokhuseleko okanye imvume.

Cela ikhaya lichaze ukhetho ngamazwi alo. Okuthandwa ngumyili akufuneki kutshintshe ngokuthe cwaka izinto eziphambili zekhaya. Rekhoda ukuba kutheni inketho enye ikhethwe, kutheni enye ibekwe ecaleni nokuba loluphi ulwazi olutsha olunokutshintsha isigqibo. Ukhetho olunemiqathango luvumelekile xa umqathango ucacile kwaye umsebenzi ochaphazelekayo ulinda.

items.key: Read [Record and check a harvest](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/harvest). The current form records kilograms and the date of entry, not a backdated picking date. The chart's “kept” is picked minus logged sold quantities; it cannot identify home use, gifts, storage or loss separately. In this workbook, 24 kg picked minus 15 kg delivered is 9 kg; that happens to equal closing stock because the 4 kg opening stock and 4 kg other outflows offset. It is a coincidence, not a general stock formula or an expected app chart result. The current invoice link adds kilogram sale evidence when an invoice is paid in full, so unpaid and partly paid deliveries do not map directly to this workbook. Use its destination records to explain the movement; do not mark an invoice paid just to force the chart to match.

Use the [learner worksheet](f2-worksheet.md) or [four-page printable workbook](../../../../output/pdf/finance-f2-workbook.pdf), a calculator, a notebook and counters representing kilograms and money. Read one event aloud at a time. Let learners point, sort cards, explain aloud or ask someone to write their answer. Introduce the second money account only after the learner can follow the cash tin. Keep real household finances, buyer details and payment credentials out of group exercises and screenshots.

All weights, prices, fees and amounts in this pack are invented for arithmetic practice. They are not local market evidence, recommended fees, budgets or yields. This is a separate four-day practice period for the fictional farm; do not carry forward or add F1's balances. The opening position is given: 4 kg of carrots already stored, R500.00 in a cash tin and R100.00 in a mobile-money wallet, with no buyer balance owed. No field area or production period is supplied, so no yield per area can be calculated.

The exercise tracks the same produce in comparable weighed condition. It excludes purchases, processing, refunds, unknown shrinkage, pending transfers, tax, loans and equipment. In real work, identify additional movements and changes in weighing conditions rather than forcing them into this example. No numerical loss allowance is recommended. Exact quantities are stored as whole grams and money as whole cents in [f2-practice.json](f2-practice.json); the teaching tables use kg and rand.

At 30 packs, calculate revenue and both kinds of included cost. Repeat for 18 packs prepared and sold. Then keep the original prices but reduce capacity to 20. The numerical break-even point does not change, but it is outside that capacity. Never recommend “sell more” without testing production capacity and evidence of demand. Expected sales are assumptions, not confirmed orders.

If price equals or is below variable cost while fixed costs remain positive, more units do not cover those fixed costs under this model. Report no feasible break-even quantity under these assumptions, not zero units. If a cost is missing, the result is unknown; an empty value is not a free input.

Discuss four cards:

1. “The app printed a VAT number, so this is a valid tax invoice.” **Not established.** A field or title alone does not establish registration, supply treatment or all required particulars. Inspect the document with the applicable current guidance.
2. “I did not need to submit a return, so no records are needed.” **Not established.** Do not infer all record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. “My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan.” **Not established.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not establish completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. “A missing stock value should be zero.” **Incorrect.** Request the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.

Xoxa ngamakhadi amane:

1. “I-app ishicilele inombolo ye-VAT, ngoko le yi-invoyisi yerhafu esebenzayo.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Indawo okanye isihloko sodwa asiseki ukubhaliswa, unyango lwenkonzo okanye zonke iinkcukacha ezifunekayo. Hlola uxwebhu ngesikhokelo sangoku esifanelekileyo.
2. “Bendingafuni ukungenisa imbuyekezo, ngoko akukho rekhodi zifunekayo.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Musa ukucinga zonke iimfanelo zeerekhodi kuloo nyani. Buza ngeemfuno ezisebenzayo nanasiphi na isibophelelo esiqhubekayo sophicotho-zincwadi, impikiswano okanye esinye.
3. “Into endiyithumele ngaphandle iyiseti epheleleyo yeeakhawunti kwaye iqinisekisa imboleko.” **Akuqinisekisiwe.** Yikhangele ngokuchasene nolunye ubungqina. Into ethunyelwe ngaphandle ayiseki ukuphela, ukuthembeka kwekhredithi okanye ukuvunywa.
4. “Ixabiso lesitokhwe elilahlekileyo kufuneka libe zero.” **Akulunganga.** Cela ukubala, ixabiso nokuvumelanisa. Musa ukufihla ulwazi olulahlekileyo njengesiphumo esilinganisiweyo.
